mapper.select: select TPD.TRADE_ID tradeId, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPD.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, FTP.IRS_TYPE irsType, TPD.VDATE vdate, TPD.MDATE mdate, FTP.TERM term, FTP.HOLD_PURPOSE holdPurpose, TPD.CCY ccy, TPD.PRIN_AMT/10000 prin, FCCR_R.Yield*100 yield, FCPR_R.PAY_CYCLE fixPayCycle, FCPR_R.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDateR, FRI_F.BENCHMARK_ID intType, FRI_F.SPREAD_RATE spreadRate, FCPR_F.PAY_CYCLE floatPayCycle, FCPR_F.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDateF, TPD.COUNTER_ID counterId, TPD.TRADER trader, TPD.REMARK remark, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TPD.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FTP.TERM_TYPE termType, FTP.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, TTFD1.FEE_AMT feeB06, TTFD2.FEE_AMT feeB07, FRI_R.BASIS fixBasis, FRI_F.BASIS floatBasis, FRI_F.RESET_FREQ resetFreq, FRI_F.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE firstResetDate, TPD.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, TPD.COUNTER_CONTACT counterContact, SFPA1.ACCT_NO dealAcct, SFPA2.ACCT_NO corAcct from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PT.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on FTP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID and FTP.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} left join FIN_RATE_INFO FRI_R on FRI_R.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID and FRI_R.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} and FRI_R.INT_TYPE = #{INT_TYPE_01} and FRI_R.EFF_DATE = FTP.VDATE left join FIN_RATE_INFO FRI_F on FRI_F.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID and FRI_F.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} and FRI_F.INT_TYPE = #{INT_TYPE_02} and FRI_F.EFF_DATE = FTP.VDATE left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR_R on FRI_R.CASH_ID = FCPR_R.CASH_ID and FCPR_R.EFF_DATE = FTP.VDATE left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR_F on FRI_F.CASH_ID = FCPR_F.CASH_ID and FCPR_F.EFF_DATE = FTP.VDATE left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR_R on FRI_R.CASH_ID = FCCR_R.CASH_ID and FCCR_R.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_YES} left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TTFD1 on TPD.TRADE_ID = TTFD1.TRADE_ID and TTFD1.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B06} left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TTFD2 on TPD.TRADE_ID = TTFD2.TRADE_ID and TTFD2.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B07} left join STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA1 on TPD.FINPROD_ID = SFPA1.FINPROD_ID and SFPA1.acct_type = #{ACCTTYPE_01} left join STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA2 on TPD.FINPROD_ID = SFPA2.FINPROD_ID and SFPA2.acct_type = #{ACCTTYPE_02} WHERE TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F14} and TPD.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'

SELECT EE.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, EE.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, EEA.DEAL_CUR_ACCT dealAcct, EEA.COR_CUR_ACCT corAcct, EE.COUNTER_ID counterId, EE.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, EE.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, (EE.ENTRUST_AMT-NVL(FINISH_AMT,0))/10000 prin, ED.TRADER trader, EEA.MATURE_YIELD*100 yield, EEA.TERM_TYPE termType, EEA.DEAL_MODE intType, EEA.BUSI_PS irsType FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD EEA ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = EEA.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ED ON ED.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) FINISH_AMT ON FINISH_AMT.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID
EE.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select t.cash_type_1 as cashTypeOne, t.cash_type_2 as cashTypeTwo, p.cash_id as cashId, p.cash_num as cashNum, p.cash_type as cashType, p.vdate_unadjust as vdateUnadjust, p.mdate_unadjust as mdateUnadjust, p.pay_date_unadjust as payDateUnadjust, p.vdate as vdate, p.mdate as mdate, p.pay_date as payDate, p.termdays, p.vdate_y as vdateY, p.vdate_term as vdateTerm, p.mdate_term as mdateTerm, p.termdays_term as termdaysTerm, p.prin_amt as prinAmt, p.int_prin_amt as intPrinAmt, p.int_amt as intAmt, 'N' as isPayInt, p.cash_amt as cashAmt, p.cash_baseamt as cashBaseamt, p.cash_unit_type as cashUnitType, p.calc_function as calcFunction, p.frequency, p.finprod_id as finprodId, p.finprod_type as finprodType, p.finprod_type2 as finprodType2, p.branch, p.pay_type as payType, p.range_yield as rangeYield, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.create_dept, p.update_user, p.update_time from FIN_CASH_INFO t left join fin_cash_plan p on t.cash_id = p.cash_id
t.finprod_id= #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.MDATE not in (select a. mdate from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a where a.ps in ('T99','T98') and a.finprod_id = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.TRADE_STATUS != '03' and a.IS_CANCEL='N' AND a.mdate is not null )
union all select t.cash_type_1 as cashTypeOne, t.cash_type_2 as cashTypeTwo, p.cash_id as cashId, p.cash_num as cashNum, p.cash_type as cashType, p.vdate_unadjust as vdateUnadjust, p.mdate_unadjust as mdateUnadjust, p.pay_date_unadjust as payDateUnadjust, p.vdate as vdate, p.mdate as mdate, p.pay_date as payDate, p.termdays, p.vdate_y as vdateY, p.vdate_term as vdateTerm, p.mdate_term as mdateTerm, p.termdays_term as termdaysTerm, p.prin_amt as prinAmt, p.int_prin_amt as intPrinAmt, p.int_amt as intAmt, 'Y' as isPayInt, p.cash_amt as cashAmt, p.cash_baseamt as cashBaseamt, p.cash_unit_type as cashUnitType, p.calc_function as calcFunction, p.frequency, p.finprod_id as finprodId, p.finprod_type as finprodType, p.finprod_type2 as finprodType2, p.branch, p.pay_type as payType, p.range_yield as rangeYield, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.create_dept, p.update_user, p.update_time from FIN_CASH_INFO t left join fin_cash_plan p on t.cash_id = p.cash_id
t.finprod_id= #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.MDATE in (select a. mdate from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a where a.ps in ('T99','T98') and a.finprod_id = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.TRADE_STATUS != '03' and a.IS_CANCEL='N' AND a.mdate is not null)
order by cashTypeTwo,vdate
select * from fin_cash_info t where t.finprod_id=#{tradeId}
